note: Separates the four restricted entries from EX.FULL, TS.FULL and TR.FULL (registry finding F5). Krämer's package with the existential principle restricted is a sub-package.
novelty: Not new as a proposal: restricting existential grounding to instances free of sentential quantifiers is Krämer's own suggestion (kramer2013, section on rejecting (X)); MG shows the suggestion is consistent in this encoding, together with typed truth, asymmetry and transitivity. Whether the literature contains a consistency proof for it was not checked

note: Separates EX.PART from EX.PRED and EX.LEV. With MG, which satisfies those two and refutes EX.PART, neither side implies the other. MH has no irreflexivity (every truth partially grounds itself), so it is a separation only, not a package of interest
